title: The grants hover reads the `nvs.toml` of the hovered file's directory and lists the `[capabilities]` roster only.
text: A handler in a file the program autoloads from another directory shows that directory's grants, not the entry's (`of_program`). The exceptions of `net.internal` and an extension's own `grants` are not listed (`list`). Grants keyed on a namespace change what a route's program may do, so the hover follows them.
